## Checklist

- [ ] I read [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/jpdevdotcom/better-catarman-northsamar/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) and followed the content rules.
- [ ] Every fact I added or changed has a source, and anything unconfirmed is labelled or left blank.
- [ ] I didn't change any quoted text (audit findings, official requirements).
- [ ] I didn't hand-edit generated data files; I reran the script in `scripts/` instead.
- [ ] If I changed English text on a page, I updated its key in `app/i18n/fil.ts` and `app/i18n/war.ts`.
- [ ] `pnpm typecheck` passes.
- [ ] `pnpm generate` builds without errors.
- [ ] I checked the change on a phone-sized and a desktop-sized window.
- [ ] No `.env`, keys, or downloaded PDFs or zips are included.

## For translations

- [ ] I'm a native speaker of the language I translated.
